explanation: Hanna-Barbera's The Flintstones began in 1960 as an evening sitcom. The studio later gave it a space-age twin, The Jetsons, set in Orbit City.

claims.text: Fred and Wilma Flintstone live in the town of Bedrock.
Orbit City is the home of The Jetsons, Jellystone is Yogi Bear's park and Springfield is the town of The Simpsons.
The Flintstones, made by Hanna-Barbera, was first broadcast in 1960, in an evening slot.
Hanna-Barbera's The Jetsons (1962) is set in Orbit City.

writerNotes: Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Claims: every claim listed, risk at or above the C26 floor and raised where a detail is easy to get wrong; the schema's riskReason list has no 'only' or 'counterintuitive', so such claims carry the nearest listed reason. Datasets: no pinned dataset covers film or TV facts, so every high-risk claim here needs checker evidence from the web. Rival test: Orbit City and Jellystone come from the same studio, and Springfield from another family cartoon, so each is a real confusion of the same kind. Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: a cartoon shown worldwide for decades; no local knowledge is needed. Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 24 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json; no claim resembles a listed myth. Mystery and encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: c3 avoids the contested claim that it was the first animated series in prime time.
